HF.root.model.rotary_emb: This is a shared RoPE embedding module (Llama4TextRotaryEmbedding) in HF that is used across all layers. In vLLM, each layer has its own RotaryEmbeddingWrapper instance at root.language_model.model.layers.{i/j}.self_attn.rotary_emb. The functionality is equivalent but the architecture differs - HF has one global instance while vLLM has per-layer wrappers. This represents an architectural difference rather than missing functionality.
HF.root.model.layers.{i}.feed_forward.exper: This SiLUActivation is part of the expert layers in HF's Llama4TextExperts. In vLLM, the expert computation is handled by FusedMoE which fuses the experts into optimized kernels. The activation function is not exposed as a separate module but is embedded within the fused operations at root.language_model.model.layers.{i}.feed_forward.experts.
HF.root.model.layers.{j}.feed_forward.exper: Same as above but for layers without qk_norm. The SiLU activation is fused into the FusedMoE kernel operations in vLLM at root.language_model.model.layers.{j}.feed_forward.experts.

vLLM.root.language_model: This is an intermediate wrapper (Llama4ForCausalLM) in vLLM. The actual model content maps to root.model in HF. This is a vLLM-specific architectural wrapper for conditional generation. The wrapper is at root level which is already mapped.
vLLM.root.language_model.model.layers.{i}.sel: RotaryEmbeddingWrapper is a vLLM-specific component that wraps a shared rotary embedding. In HF, there's a single shared rotary_emb at root.model.rotary_emb. This is an architectural difference in how RoPE is organized - vLLM uses per-layer wrappers while HF uses a single shared instance.

RadixAttention is vLLM's optimized attention implementation using PagedAttention with radix tree-based KV cache management. In HF, the attention computation is embedded directly within the Llama4TextAttention forward method without a separate attention module. This is a framework-specific optimization and a KEY COMPONENT that is likely related to the page_size > 1 bug, as it manages paged memory layout for KV cache.
vLLM.root.language_model.model.layers.{i}.fee: TopK is a vLLM-specific module for expert selection in MoE. In HF, the expert selection logic is embedded within the Llama4TextMoe forward method, with Llama4Router computing router logits and top-k selection done inline.

UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod is a vLLM quantization infrastructure component. Since the HF model is not using quantization, there's no corresponding component. This is infrastructure for future quantization support.
vLLM.root.language_model.model.layers.{j}.sel: Same as {i} layers - RotaryEmbeddingWrapper is vLLM-specific, corresponds to shared root.model.rotary_emb in HF.

Same as {i} layers - RadixAttention is vLLM-specific PagedAttention implementation, likely related to page_size bug. This component handles KV cache with configurable page sizes. CRITICAL for debugging the page_size > 1 issue.
vLLM.root.language_model.model.layers.{j}.fee: Same as {i} layers - TopK is vLLM-specific for MoE routing, embedded in HF's Llama4TextMoe.
Same as {i} layers - quantization infrastructure, no HF equivalent.
vLLM.root.language_model.logits_processor: LogitsProcessor is a vLLM-specific component for post-processing logits (sampling, beam search, temperature, top-p, etc.). HF handles this differently through GenerationConfig and generation utilities, not as a model component.
vLLM.root.language_model.pooler: Pooler is a vLLM component for pooling operations (used in embedding models). Llama4 for causal LM doesn't use pooling in HF, as it's for next-token prediction, not sequence embedding.
vLLM.root.logits_processor: Duplicate LogitsProcessor at root level in vLLM. This is part of vLLM's serving infrastructure for handling multiple models/modalities. Not present in HF's single-model architecture.
